
## Transcription

#### Front face

Ebenezer White

Died Oct. 31, 1852.
Aged 74 years.

His wife

Candace Smith

Died Jan. 27, 1850.

Aged 67 years.

Adaline White

Daughter of E. & C. White

Died Oct. 31. 1890.

Aged 84 years.


#### Rear face

Erected by

Adaline White

To the memory of

her parents.

and sisters.
